title: test(plugin-view): fold six more ObjectView pins over stand-in child renderers onto the shared harness
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoPC4ctRn1a3NwUssAZhqxBe)_
Part of #29469

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:视图组件 `ObjectView`(`plugin-view` 包)再有 6 个单卡测试文件并入上一片(#30872)建好的共享测试文件 `ObjectView.harness.test.tsx`,每个原文件变成一个顶层 `describe`,断言和标题一字未改;另有 3 个测试文件里点名这些文件的注释改成点名对应的块。
- **为什么改**:#29469 第三族 ObjectView 的第二片,也是这一族最后一个 PR(席位修订 2:每族最多两个 PR)。本地同机实测,这 6 个文件的 CPU 从约 36 秒降到并入后约 8 秒;没有并入的 ObjectView 测试(`plugin-view` 39 个、`app-shell` 87 个)按共享的 setup 列在正文末尾。
- **风险与回滚**:只动测试文件,不改源码、门禁、CI,不发布任何东西;块之间串状态的风险用探针在原顺序和三种乱序下排除。`formTitleNoProviderFallback` 和 `createGrant-12082` 依赖 `ui/vitest.setup.i18n-global.ts` 每个测试后复原 react-i18next 全局实例:临时关掉那一步,这两块 7 个测试变红,恢复后全绿。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ObjectView.formTitleNoProviderFallback` 一块的文档注释(原来写着"必须单独成文件",现在说明为什么可以同文件),再看 `ObjectView.formTitleI18n.test.tsx` 改过的那段注释。
- **两分钟验证**:在 `ui/` 下跑 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.harness.test.tsx`,应见 1 个文件、119 个测试全过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。
- **席位意见**:ui 席 2 对照 head `f5053769` 的 diff 复核:10 个文件,6 个 ObjectView 单卡文件并入已有的 plugin-view 共享文件,另 3 个文件只改指向被并文件的注释(其一在 plugin-form,超出认领面但仅 1 行注释);断言与标题一字未改(`it(` 61=61、`expect(` 113=113),乱序三种种子全过;2,867 行未过 3,000 行线;CI 全绿,纯测试改动无发布面,不欠契约复审。未并入的 39 个 plugin-view 文件与 87 个 app-shell 文件已在正文列明。同意落地。

## What changes

Slice 3b, the second and last `ObjectView*` PR of the shared-setup rollout (ruling 6583487846 on #29469; seat amendment 2, 6672694520: at most two PRs per family). Six more pins in `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/` that render the real `ObjectView` over the three-mock trio join `ObjectView.harness.test.tsx`, which slice 3a (#30872) created:

- The three clean trio pins left after 3a: `tableColumnsForwarding`, `strayGroupByLane-9242` and `canonicalTableKeys`. Then the three smallest trio pins that pass every census check except that another file names them: `createGrant-12082`, `calendarBinding-7029` and `formTitleNoProviderFallback`.
- Each former file is a top-level `describe` named after its file stem, with its docblock above it, appended after the nine 3a blocks. Its first lines are `restoreAfterBlock()` and a `beforeEach` that installs its three stand-ins, each copied verbatim from that file's mock factory; everything else is moved verbatim, re-indented by two spaces. A module-level `beforeEach` / `afterEach` of a former file is now the block's own hook. The 6 files are deleted. The harness goes from 9 to 15 top-level `describe` blocks. No 3a block, and no line of the header, the mocks or `restoreAfterBlock()`, changed.
- The import list gains one line: `MePermissionsProvider` and the type `MePermissionsAuthenticatedResponse` from `@object-ui/permissions`, which `createGrant-12082` used.
- **`formTitleNoProviderFallback` said it had to be its own file.** Its docblock explained that a mounted `I18nProvider` installs react-i18next's global instance and that this survives `cleanup()`, so a provider-less render later in the same file would assert nothing. That no longer holds: `ui/vitest.setup.i18n-global.ts` (objectui#4514) puts back the pointer the file inherited after every test. The section is rewritten to say so, and keeps the rule not to mount a provider in that block. Measured both ways: the block runs after `ObjectView.formLabelsI18nLabel-10993`, which mounts a zh provider, and passes in declaration order and under three shuffled orders; with the reset's `setI18n` call disabled for one throwaway run, 7 tests go red (the 4 of `formTitleNoProviderFallback` and 3 of `createGrant-12082`, whose `New` button label resolves through the same global), and the other 112 stay green. The probe below also reads `getI18n()` as `undefined` at every block's start.

**Comments that named a folded file** (amendment 2: test files are updated, source files stay):

- `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.formTitleI18n.test.tsx` named `ObjectView.formTitleNoProviderFallback.test.tsx` and why it lived elsewhere; it now names the block and the setup file.
- `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.ganttBinding-7070.test.tsx` named `ObjectView.calendarBinding-7029` as its sibling next door; it now names the block.
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx` named `ObjectView.createGrant-12082.test.tsx` as the opener's runtime pin; it now names the block.

The two `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/` files that name `ObjectView.calendarBinding-7029` (`ObjectView.galleryBinding-7547`, `ObjectView.ganttBinding-7070`) mean app-shell's own `ObjectView.calendarBinding-7029.test.tsx`, which stays, so they are unchanged. `git grep` of each of the 6 stems over `ui`, `scripts`, `packages`, `content`, `apps` and `.github` finds no other hit outside `CHANGELOG.md` history.

Test files only: no source file, no changeset (`skip-changeset`). `@object-ui/plugin-view` and `@object-ui/plugin-form` build from their entries with `vite build`, and no entry imports a test file.

## Tests

### Former file → describe (no title or assertion dropped)

TypeScript AST walk of each former file at `8b9cc712` (the `main` this was cut from, where they still exist) against the `describe` of the same name in the harness at this PR's head. An `it` is a call to `it` / `test` (an `it.each(...)(...)` counts once); titles are the `describe > it` paths under the block, compared as sorted lists.

| former file | it before | it after | expect( before | expect( after | titles identical |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|:-:|
| `ObjectView.tableColumnsForwarding.test.tsx` | 14 | 14 | 21 | 21 | yes |
| `ObjectView.strayGroupByLane-9242.test.tsx` | 9 | 9 | 21 | 21 | yes |
| `ObjectView.canonicalTableKeys.test.tsx` | 27 | 27 | 47 | 47 | yes |
| `ObjectView.createGrant-12082.test.tsx` | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | yes |
| `ObjectView.calendarBinding-7029.test.tsx` | 3 | 3 | 13 | 13 | yes |
| `ObjectView.formTitleNoProviderFallback.test.tsx` | 4 | 4 | 7 | 7 | yes |
| **total** | 61 | 61 | 113 | 113 | yes |

The whole harness: 47 `it` / 97 `expect(` at `8b9cc712`, 108 / 210 at this head (47 + 61, 97 + 113); no statement outside the blocks holds an `it` or `expect(`. The 108 `it` calls run as 119 tests (`it.each` rows), 55 of them the 3a blocks.

The diff adds one import line and appends after the last 3a block (`ObjectView.filterSources`); it removes no line of the harness.

### CPU before and after (local A/B, one machine)

**CI after: NOT MEASURED**: the per-file timings reporter (#29517) uploads on `main`'s full-battery runs only. Its first after-reading is the first full-battery `main` run after this merges.

Local A/B on one 4-vCPU container, under `os-verify-lock` (shared-box seconds), same command both legs, from `ui/`: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView. --maxWorkers=2` (every `ObjectView.*` file in that directory, `ObjectView.test.tsx` included), with a throwaway reporter summing each module's `diagnostic()`. Fixed = environment + prepare + setup + collect (import). The "before" leg writes the 6 files and the harness from `8b9cc712` into the branch's tree, so both legs run the same 40 other files; run order before, after, before, after.

| | files | tests passed | fixed CPU | test CPU | total CPU | wall |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| ObjectView family in plugin-view, before (run 1 / 2) | 47 | 507 | 220.5 / 225.8 s | 26.3 / 26.5 s | 246.8 / 252.3 s | 128.8 / 131.8 s |
| ObjectView family in plugin-view, after (run 1 / 2) | 41 | 507 | 222.1 / 194.2 s | 29.9 / 25.9 s | 252.0 / 220.1 s | 131.7 / 114.7 s |
| the 6 + the harness, before (run 1 / 2) | 7 | 119 | 32.8 / 32.3 s | 3.1 / 3.0 s | 35.9 / 35.3 s | |
| the harness, after (run 1 / 2) | 1 | 119 | 6.3 / 5.2 s | 2.8 / 2.5 s | 9.1 / 7.6 s | |

The 6 files took 29.2 / 29.0 s of CPU on their own; the harness grew from 6.7 / 6.3 s to 9.1 / 7.6 s to hold them, so the fold saves about 27 s of CPU (−76 % for those seven files together). The family read 249.6 s before and 236.0 s after on average (−5.4 %), and wall 130.3 s to 123.2 s; the two after runs differ by 31.9 s, so that family figure is a reading inside this box's run-to-run spread, not a measured saving; the per-file figures above are the measurement. Across both slices the nine 3a files and these six, 15 files and 2,802 lines, now load the module graph once.

## Acceptance notes

- **Why these 6, and not the whole ask.** The seat's 3b order named the 3 clean pins, the trio pins another test file names, and the app-shell `ObjectView` pins in a second harness. Measured at `8b9cc712`, that is about 14,000 changed lines: the 3 clean pins are 1,081 lines, the named-by trio pins about 3,300 more, and the app-shell pins 25,358 lines over 20 different mock-module sets. The dev reported that to the seat before writing anything, and the seat agreed (09:06Z) to the 3 clean pins plus the smallest named-by trio pins that fit the 3,000-line bar. 1,485 lines moved make 2,867 changed lines; the next smallest eligible pin (`ObjectView.rowColorRelay-7218`, 175 lines) would take it past 3,000.
- **This is ObjectView's last PR under amendment 2,** so every `ObjectView.*` pin left unfolded is listed below by the setup it shares, from this head's tree. Whether to fold further is a new card the seat files (amendment 2). Two of the rows are not candidates at all: `contractEnvelope-6726` is named by path in `ui/scripts/check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs`, a ledger outside `__tests__`, so it stays a file of its own; `galleryBlockNested-12053` registers its tests from a `for` loop over its routes at collection time.
- **The app-shell pins are another family.** They test the Console's `ObjectView` in `@object-ui/app-shell`, a different component from `@object-ui/plugin-view`'s, and none of them uses the trio. Their largest dom clusters share a base of `./MetadataInspector`, `./RecordDetailView`, `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/collaboration` and `@object-ui/permissions` mocks but differ in the rest of the set (and, file by file, in the overridden keys), so a fold there needs its own harness in `app-shell` and its own census; the seat judges whether that is a separate card. 12 dom files there mock nothing (2,548 lines), the natural first cluster for such a harness; 12 more mock nothing but are `.test.ts` files in the `unit` project, which is not isolated per file, so folding them saves nothing.
- `formTitleNoProviderFallback` and `createGrant-12082` fold cleanly only because the `ui/` setup resets react-i18next's global after every test (the reverse run above is the evidence); a later change to `ui/vitest.setup.i18n-global.ts` is the thing that would undo it, and the rewritten docblock says so.
- The harness header and the moved docblocks name the former files' issue numbers in prose, as the 3a blocks do; no new citation line is added outside moved text.

## Verification

At head `f5053769`, after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and the closure build from slice 3a (`turbo run build` for `@objectstack/spec`, `formula`, `lint`, `client`, `metadata-protocol`, then `--filter='@object-ui/plugin-view^...'` from `ui/`), every run under `os-verify-lock`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-view/ packages/plugin-form/src/affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx --maxWorkers=2` from `ui/` (VERDICT command-exit 0): 66 files, 775 tests, all passed. That is the 65 plugin-view files left after this PR plus the edited plugin-form file.
